implementation.name: Atari7800 (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 73 HDL source files (20 systemverilog, 33 verilog, 20 vhdl) alongside 7 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Atari 7800, which is also the core the distribution's _Console/Atari 2600.mgl shortcut launches (<rbf>_Console/Atari7800</rbf>) because the 7800 hardware runs 2600 cartridges, giving machine_id a7800 and machine_id a2600. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Atari7800_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is neither an SPDX id in data/lookup/license.json nor a license text this build could match to one (it reads 'Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International ================'). Recording a guess would be worse than the IMPL_UNVERIFIED_LICENSE warning. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 73 source files (20 systemverilog, 33 verilog, 20 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.

implementation_dependency.note: JT51 YM2151 core vendored at rtl/jt51/jt51.v
